name: sharepoint-lists-enterprise
description: Reads and writes SharePoint lists and list items through Microsoft Graph.

risk.read: external Microsoft Graph API read of SharePoint list and list-item data
risk.write: creates/updates SharePoint lists and list items (rows and their column values) on the configured site via Microsoft Graph
risk.approval: none for list/list-item create-update (low-risk CRM/CMS-style data, no destructive deletes implemented)
